accepted_scope: Inert new candidate directory and navigation only; no existing checkout/document/frozen metadata mutation, commit, push or target execution.

checks.name: candidate writes use new Root-owned directory and exclusive file modes
new Python evidence is made inert py.source
primary checkout constant is not a mutation receiver
per supplied metadata candidate cap retained

findings.issue: add() copies one buffer but records original_source with a separate later source.read_bytes(). A changed source can produce different original/candidate pins while exact_original_bytes_preserved remains true.
findings.requested_fix: Derive original_source from exactly the bytes written. Independently read back the candidate and require length/hash equality before asserting preservation; if a fresh Source post-read is required, compare it to that same buffer and retain a typed refusal instead of claiming exact preservation.

findings.issue: The saved-results gate checks only that a filename exists; it does not read the Root adoption, its ACCEPT verdict or held authority fields. An empty/refused/unrelated file passes this claimed accepted-outcome gate.
findings.requested_fix: Read the forthcoming exact Root adoption and require author=/root, the exact accepted saved-result verdict/flags and its exact accepted final Source/result pins as soon as its final schema exists. Likewise join the verified workspace report to its different saved-results adoption rather than treating a report verdict as adoption by itself.

review_method: Whole bytes, AST, source trace only; subject was not imported, compiled for execution, invoked or dry-run.
